title: 第62章 万炮齐鸣轰谅山
content_zh:
第62章 万炮齐鸣轰谅山-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》
上一章
存书签

379团负责搜索城内残敌，在搜索残敌的时候，九连遇到了不少脱光的母猴子，嗷嗷叫的冲上来。在有战士因为害羞吃过亏之后，大家也不再手软。
敌人对巷子熟悉，9连出现了多名伤亡。不过巷战和游击战都是中国人教的，尽管部队多年没打过游击战，但是靠着一套套战术，很快击毙数百名残敌。
打巷战的前提是有巷子，没巷子了看你怎么打！
3月1号，早上各部队继续对城区进行搜索，各种型号的炮弹朝着街道疯狂地招呼。昨天晚上枪炮响了一晚，累了就换部队上。
打烂了就打烂了，反正又不打算长久在这里驻扎，拍拍屁股就走了，管你那么多。
喷火兵在巷战中也发挥了巨大的优势，犄角疙瘩的地方枪打不进去，手榴弹扔不进去，但是火能进去。
无论是乡下的坑道清剿，还是城区的肃清，喷火兵都在挨个点“熟人”的名字，九连更是将火用到了极致。
禄平和谅山周围，有许多的喀斯特地貌，这种地方形成的天然岩洞是躲猫猫的好地方，也是喷火器的理想战场。
清晨，刘济民在枪炮声中醒来，揉了揉眼睛，立即戴上了军帽。旁边的文书正坐在小板凳上写东西，刘济民踢了踢凳子，问道：“连长他们回来了吗？”
“连长在隔壁睡了，副连长在前面指挥。指导员，您这一觉睡得可真够好的，外面榴弹炮开火，工兵炸了破雷桥，愣是没把您吵醒。不过呀，屋里面的声音更大。”文书笑着说道。
破雷桥是越南奇穷河上的关键桥梁，炸了它，就能阻断越南人关键运输通道。
刘济民眉毛一挑：“我打呼噜了？扯淡，老子睡觉从来不打呼噜！”
“谁说您打呼噜了？我可没说！”文书嘿嘿一笑，将手中的材料递给了刘济民。
“就是嘛，我从来不打呼噜！”
“我只听到了您呀，在睡梦中带着咱们全连吹响了胜利的号角声！”文书一本正经地说道。
刘济民头也不抬地说道：“别总是说这些发自肺腑的话！”
神经紧绷了一天一夜，刘济民回来躺在地上就睡着了。这种高强度的紧张状态下，打呼噜自然是再正常不过了。
“是是是，您看看这战报还有没有什么要改的。”
“写得不错，不过有的地方要改一下。这里‘击毙十七人’，改成‘全歼十七名守敌，无一人受伤’。还有这里，‘突入街区，对禄平街区迅速完成分割’。改成‘九连率先攻入禄平，直插敌核心阵地，快速完成分割包围，为全师攻下禄平开辟胜利通道。’”刘济民说完将文件递给了文书，再次说：

The 379th Regiment was responsible for searching for remnants of enemies in the city. While searching for remnants of enemies, the Ninth Company encountered many naked female monkeys, who rushed up to them screaming. After some soldiers suffered losses because of shyness, everyone no longer showed mercy.
The enemy was familiar with the alley, and the 9th Company suffered many casualties. However, street fighting and guerrilla warfare were both taught by the Chinese. Although the troops had not fought guerrilla warfare for many years, they relied on a set of tactics to quickly kill hundreds of remaining enemies.
The prerequisite for street fighting is that there are alleys. If there are no alleys, it depends on how you fight!
In the morning of March 1st, the troops continued to search the urban area, and various types of artillery shells were fired wildly at the streets. The gunfire went off all night last night. When I got tired, I changed troops.
If it's broken, then break it. Anyway, I don't plan to stay here for a long time, so I just pat my butt and leave, no matter what you do.
The flamethrowers also played a huge advantage in street fighting. Guns and grenades couldn't penetrate the bumps on their horns, but fire could penetrate.
Whether it was clearing out tunnels in the countryside or clearing out urban areas, the fire-breathing soldiers were calling the names of "acquaintances" one by one, and the Ninth Company used fire to the extreme.
There are many karst landforms around Luk Binh and Lang Son. The natural caves formed in such places are a good place for hide-and-seek and an ideal battlefield for flamethrowers.
In the early morning, Liu Jimin woke up to the sound of gunfire, rubbed his eyes, and immediately put on his military cap. The clerk next to him was sitting on a small bench writing something. Liu Jimin kicked the bench and asked, "Are the company commander and the others back?"
"The company commander is sleeping next door, and the deputy company commander is commanding from the front. Instructor, you had a good sleep this time. The howitzers opened fire outside and the engineers blew up the Thunder Bridge, but they didn't wake you up. However, the noise inside the room was louder." The clerk said with a smile.
The Polei Bridge is a key bridge on the Qiqiong River in Vietnam. If it is blown up, it can block the key transportation channel for the Vietnamese.
Liu Jimin raised his eyebrows: "Am I snoring? That's nonsense, I never snore when I sleep!"
"Who said you snore? I didn't say that!" The clerk smiled and handed the materials in his hand to Liu Jimin.
"That's right, I never snore!"
"I only heard you, leading our whole company to blow the trumpet of victory in your sleep!" the clerk said seriously.
Liu Jimin said without raising his head: "Don't always say these words from the bottom of your heart!"
After being tense all day and night, Liu Jimin came back and lay down on the ground and fell asleep. In this high-intensity state of tension, snoring is naturally normal.
"Yes, yes, please see if there is anything to change in this battle report."
"The writing is good, but some places need to be changed. Here, 'killed seventeen people', changed to 'annihilated seventeen defenders, no one was injured'. And here, 'break into the block, quickly complete the division of Luping Block'. Changed to 'Ninth Company took the lead in attacking Luping, penetrated directly into the enemy's core position, quickly completed the division and encirclement, and opened a victory channel for the entire division to capture Luping.'" After finishing speaking, Liu Jimin handed the document to the clerk and said again:
